second_order: building and reshaping the Funhaus mark
theme_note: People propose the mark, choose coordinates, lay its shape and colours, and revise its form pixel by pixel.

second_order: calling people to protect and repair the logo
theme_note: People identify damage or pressure, direct corrections, summon defenders, and take shifts keeping the work alive.

second_order: working out borders and peace with neighbours
theme_note: People pass on border advice and announce peace so neighboring works can coexist.

second_order: celebrating and crediting the pixel work
theme_note: People praise the logo, remember its growth, claim or distribute credit, and announce milestones while work may continue.

second_order: playing along with the Game Attack takeover
theme_note: People repeat the imposed identity, praise or mock its theme, pretend confusion, and call for Funhaus back; this is the subreddit joke, not canvas work.

second_order: turning pixel changes into room jokes
theme_note: People name altered versions of the work, laugh at them, and keep the joke alongside the burden of repair.

second_order: sharing where the work is and how it changes
theme_note: People post coordinates, updates, progression tools, and views so others can locate or follow the canvas work.

second_order: owning and forgiving accidental pixel damage
theme_note: People confess mistaken placements or misspellings and answer accidental harm with forgiveness rather than treating it as an attack.

second_order: asking for a Discord for the work
theme_note: A participant asks whether the canvas effort has a Discord; the record shows the request but no visible move of organizing.

second_order: seeking approval and reacting to criticism
theme_note: People ask whether they are doing the work correctly, want valued people to notice it, or threaten to leave after their contribution is criticized.

second_order: making one place for r/place talk
theme_note: People call for the room to discuss r/place and then make a megathread for all place needs so the rest of the subreddit can return to ordinary business.

second_order: calling the split pixel work Hard Nettin’
theme_note: A participant uses the older room phrase Hard Nettin’ for dividing pixel time between maintaining Funhaus and altering another logo.
